description: This file defines the ConsoleMessage class, which models console messages within the Playwright core server. It includes properties like type, text, arguments, location, and associated page or worker, along with methods to access these properties.

classes.name: ConsoleMessage
classes.description: A class representing a console message, including details such as message type, text, arguments, location, and associated page or worker.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Returns the associated Page object or null.

methods.name: worker
methods.description: Returns the associated Worker object or null.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of the console message.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Returns the text content of the message, constructing it from arguments if not initially set.

methods.name: args
methods.description: Returns the array of argument handles associated with the message.

methods.name: location
methods.description: Returns the location information (URL, line, column) of the message.
